sentences.text: Conquest of the Planet of the Apes is a 1972 science fiction film directed by J. Lee Thompson and written by Paul Dehn .	J. Lee Thompson	J. Lee Thompson	Paul Dehn	Paul Dehn	science fiction film	science fiction film	Planet of the Apes	Planet of the Apes

The film stars Roddy McDowall , Don Murray and Ricardo Montalbán .	Roddy McDowall	Roddy McDowall	Don Murray	Don Murray (actor)	Ricardo Montalbán	Ricardo Montalbán
